title: Derivation
description: The lineage of an assertion: what it came from, and who or what produced it. Maps to W3C PROV-O: wasDerivedFrom, wasGeneratedBy, wasAttributedTo. A claim without a derivation is not admitted.

assertion.description: The assertion this derivation is for.

wasDerivedFrom.description: Inputs: episodes, other assertions, receipts, or external references (e.g. dsor:read/Q-311). External refs may rot; inputs inside the record are preferred (issue #3).

wasGeneratedBy.description: The principal or extraction run that produced the claim: 'agent:ap-clerk', 'person:officer1', 'model-run:mr-91'.

wasAttributedTo.description: Who the claim is attributed to (PROV-O), when it differs from the generator — e.g. a person for a confirmed claim produced by a tool.

recompute.description: Set when this derivation was recomputed because a source claim was superseded (B-18). Recompute creates new records; it never edits old ones.

supersededClaim.description: The superseded claim whose correction triggered recompute.
